domains.title: Bootstrap / Build

persistence.responsibility: Module/assembly identity only; no gameplay SyncData.

domains.failureFallback: Unsupported or ambiguous API selection fails closed.

domains.title: Host / Composition

persistence.responsibility: Registration is not a domain save owner.

domains.failureFallback: Contribution failures must remain isolated.

domains.title: Runtime / Diagnostics

persistence.responsibility: Runtime generation/queue state is process-local.

domains.failureFallback: Reject stale work and preserve bounded diagnostics.

domains.title: GameAdapter / Compatibility

persistence.responsibility: Compatibility adapters add no save identity.

domains.failureFallback: Missing capability falls through to supported native behavior.

domains.title: Persistence / Config

persistence.responsibility: Catalog existing owner key/type/chunk/config precedence.

domains.failureFallback: Legacy-first load and owner-local corruption isolation.

domains.title: Conversation / Encounter

persistence.responsibility: Conversation/Memory owners retain history and target state.

domains.failureFallback: Fallback only before commit; stale/started commits never replay.
blockingGates: Native main/player/proactive flows retain the legacy default; detached Native remains opt-in
Scene main generation uses the new default with shared scene-owned postprocess/actions/relay/memory
Courier delivered reply uses the detached default; inbound detached API remains opt-in
Current-candidate live acceptance is required before any further default cutover

domains.title: Gateway / Prompt / Protocol

persistence.responsibility: Requests are transient; domain owners persist accepted results.

domains.failureFallback: Timeout/cancel/retry/empty/protocol errors never fabricate facts.

domains.title: Action / Commit

persistence.responsibility: Receipts are process-local except explicit durable sidecars.

domains.failureFallback: Reject stale/tampered plans; preserve known/unknown effects without replay.

domains.title: Memory / AFEF

persistence.responsibility: MyBehavior owns history, memory and bounded recovery/weekly receipts.

domains.failureFallback: Persist only owner-confirmed facts; unknown remains fail-closed.

domains.title: Economy / Reward / Debt

persistence.responsibility: RewardSystem owns asset/item/trust/debt/merchant state.

domains.failureFallback: Stale/partial/unknown effects retain only observed facts.

domains.title: Policy / Political

persistence.responsibility: Policy records/effects/targets retain domain save owners.

domains.failureFallback: Invalid repair/authority/target rejects before delayed effects.

domains.title: World Simulation / WorldMap

persistence.responsibility: World behaviors retain distinct save namespaces.

domains.failureFallback: Destroyed/stale targets reject or use native fallback.

domains.title: Settlement / Siege / GCCZ / SETS

persistence.responsibility: Siege/settlement owners retain keys and active-stage state.

domains.failureFallback: Active-stage guards fall through to ordinary AF/native scenes.

domains.title: Scene / Mission / Combat

persistence.responsibility: Mission state clears on end; campaign owners stay separate.

domains.failureFallback: Inapplicable native combat contexts fall through without effects.

domains.title: Duel

persistence.responsibility: Only legacy cooldown data is persisted; typed Duel outcome/readback is bounded process-local and never replays effects on load.

domains.failureFallback: Exact Native/Scene Duel dispatch binds one request to one process-local DuelId before side effects; the current interaction result is final, and accepted or uncertain dispatch is non-retryable even while the outcome owner later advances the same DuelId. Courier exact dispatch is rejected. Legacy-unbound dispatch remains isolated; invalid target/scene/stake fails closed without action fallback or cross-Duel artifacts.
blockingGates: Real old-save load and post-save reload

domains.title: Courier / Proactive / Issue

persistence.responsibility: Courier/proactive/issue keep distinct state and vanilla authority.

domains.failureFallback: Courier stale/duplicates stop; invalid Issue paths return to vanilla.

domains.title: Social / Progression / Reports

persistence.responsibility: Social/report/item/Notoriety owners retain state and migrations.

domains.failureFallback: Unknown receipts never reroll; migrations/cooldowns fail closed.

domains.title: Knowledge / Persona / Profile

persistence.responsibility: Knowledge/persona/profile keep separate file/config/save authority.

domains.failureFallback: Missing model/index/provider falls back without publishing stale results.

domains.title: UI / TTS / External Integration

persistence.responsibility: UI is transient; mappings/config retain current owners.

domains.failureFallback: UI/TTS/optional integrations fail non-fatally and never own gameplay truth.

domains.title: Tools / Content / Package

persistence.responsibility: Tools/content/package are not gameplay save owners; protect PlayerExports/ONNX.

domains.failureFallback: Tools fail closed and never deploy or execute evidence implicitly.

blockingGates: Optional runtime wiring is declared only; mandatory interaction safety is not a configurable bridge
